title: Left Edge Sneaker Stays Visible
tests: Tests subject-aware reframing of an off-centre product instead of a default centre crop that loses the subject.

faults.what: The sneaker is not preserved unchanged: it appears taller relative to its length, and the collar, laces, stitching and sole contours differ from the source. This exceeds the requested square-format adjustment with no other edits.

judge.summary: The output is square and keeps the entire sneaker with neutral padding, but it alters the product instead of preserving the original photograph unchanged.

must_haves.why: The output has equal width and height.

must_haves.item: The output includes the original left-side sneaker, not an empty crop of the middle of the source.
must_haves.why: The white sneaker is clearly included and prominently framed.

must_haves.item: The complete sneaker remains visible, including toe, heel and sole.
must_haves.why: The toe, heel, upper and entire sole are visible with space around them.

must_haves.item: The sneaker's proportions, colour and details match the source.
must_haves.why: The white colour is retained, but the shoe appears proportionally taller and has changed collar, lace, stitching and sole details.

must_haves.item: Any added padding blends with the source background, with no text or decorative additions.
must_haves.why: The padding is plain light grey consistent with the source's neutral background, with no added text or decoration.
